spec_match.rationale: Demonstrates both spec forms — alpha(from … / N%) replacement and calc(alpha * k) scaling with the alpha keyword's number semantics — and probes support with CSS.supports on those exact declarations.

interactive.rationale: Color picker, two sliders, and mode toggles rebuild the declaration, painted swatch, and getComputedStyle read-back live; this pass drove the mode toggle via CDP and observed aria-pressed flip, the param label change, the decl switching to the calc(alpha * 0.4) form, and the computed read-back updating.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The blurb promises replace-vs-scale, a checkerboard swatch, the exact declaration, and real computed read-back — all delivered.

edge_cases.rationale: Origin-with-own-alpha, replace vs scale, and a two-tier honest fallback (rgb(from …) then plain sRGB, both labelled) cover the failure modes, with the unsupported banner citing the listing/detail/at-risk status discrepancy.

references.rationale: ChromeStatus 5070160203481088 (verified) and the css-color-5 relative-alpha spec anchor are linked.

conformance.rationale: The suite asserts the real contract (parse forms, computed replacement, calc scaling, none handling, display-p3 space preservation); its 8/8 failure in this Chromium 141 session is environment-expected since alpha() has not shipped here. Suite untouched.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141.0.7390.37 via CDP: fallback branch verified live (screenshot, computed read-back color(srgb 0 0.133333 1 / 0.4), mode toggle driven, clean console except the environmental fonts.googleapis.com failure, no overflow at 1280x1600 or 360x740 DPR3); the native alpha() branch remains unreachable in this browser.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts distinguish native-paint success from labelled-fallback state, plus injected global error capture.

design_system.rationale: The pressed-button chip defect is fixed: .mode-btn[aria-pressed="true"] code is now transparent-background ivory-on-black with an ivory border (computed-style verified color rgb(253,252,248) / background transparent on the black button; pixel scan shows crisp ivory glyphs on the dark surface in both pressed states), while the unpressed chip stays black-on-stone.

accessibility.rationale: Mode buttons use aria-pressed, the declaration line is aria-live, controls are labelled native inputs, and all swatch state is mirrored as text read-backs.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Verified at 1280x1600 and 360x740 DPR3 touch via CDP emulation with no horizontal overflow on either class, consistent with the harness-recorded ok/ok (2026-07-24).

openQuestions.title: Re-verify the native branch once alpha() ships in stable
openQuestions.detail: The v152 listing says enabled-by-default while the detail says Proposed and the draft marks the feature at-risk; this session's Chromium 141 can only exercise the fallback. When a build with alpha() is available, verify the native swatch, computed serialization, and the conformance suite going 8/8.

guidanceConsulted.query: WCAG contrast for button pressed state dark background inline code chip
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: When a parent surface flips to a dark scheme, nested components with their own light backgrounds must be restyled so every text/background pair keeps meeting AA.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Added .mode-btn[aria-pressed="true"] code { background: transparent; border-color: var(--bg-ivory); color: var(--bg-ivory); } so the chip renders ivory-on-black (~19:1) in the pressed state; the unpressed chip keeps the global black-on-stone pair.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: Computed styles for both pressed states (mode-replace and mode-scale) and a pixel scan of the pressed Scale button showing ivory text on the black background.

guidanceConsulted.query: layering translucent color over checkerboard pattern with CSS background layers stacking context
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Verify checkerboard-under-swatch layering paints the translucent fill above the pattern.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: No change needed here: the swatch pattern uses a child .swatch-fill above the negative-z checkerboard pseudo, which paints correctly (unlike the sibling translucent-tokens page, which was fixed).
guidanceConsulted.evidence: Fallback swatch screenshot shows the translucent blue over the checkerboard.

summary: Fixed in place with a three-property rule: the code chips inside the pressed mode toggle were ivory-on-stone (~1.02:1, invisible) because the global code rule kept its stone background when the button flipped dark; they are now transparent-background ivory-on-black with an ivory border, verified by computed styles and pixel scans in both pressed states, with the unpressed chip untouched. Mode-toggle interaction, declaration/read-back updates, clean console (environmental fonts failure only), and no overflow were confirmed on desktop and mobile viewports via CDP in headless Chromium 141. Native alpha() remains unavailable here, so the fallback branch is still the verified path.
